findings.title: Default write validation bypasses Role Policy and Agent Assignment
findings.failure_condition: A concrete changed path is inside the four-layer Phase/Intent/Classification/Blueprint task scope but outside every applicable role-policy/agent-assignment effective scope, and validate-change-scope is invoked without the optional --role or the handoff is checked by validateTask.

reproduction.construction: Task effective write=.codex/tasks/GOV-PROBE/**; sole qa-engineer effective write=.codex/tasks/GOV-PROBE/allowed/**; changed path=.codex/tasks/GOV-PROBE/unassigned.txt.

findings.impact: The public default path does not enforce the advertised single six-layer write lattice. Omitting --role or using Task handoff validation converts Role Policy and Agent Assignment from mandatory authorities into optional checks.
findings.required_resolution: Require an exact actor role or derive it from a validated unique assignment, then validate every changed path only against that role's six-layer effective scope. Reject absent, ambiguous, empty, or non-writing role authority. Add production and mutation cases for a Task-allowed but assignment-disallowed path.

findings.title: Commit execution can be forged with a caller boolean and generic PASS prerequisites
findings.failure_condition: Stored WORKSPACE_CANDIDATE and STAGED_EXACT objects are schema-valid, the programmatic caller supplies liveStagedProofValidated=true, and scope_validation/preapproval_gate contain arbitrary distinct evidence_ref strings with status PASS.

reproduction.method: Temporary production-path variant using validateTask; candidate sources were not modified
reproduction.key_fact: No live staged-validator receipt was produced or bound. The STAGED_EXACT staged set hashes were arbitrary syntactically valid hashes, while scope and preapproval were generic Task-authored PASS objects.

findings.impact: The consuming production gate cannot prove that validate-staged-candidate actually checked the current Git index, and it cannot prove designated scope/preapproval executions. This preserves the incorrect-GO family identified by A4-CODE-BLOCKER-002.
findings.required_resolution: Replace liveStagedProofValidated with a validator-produced, payload-bound live receipt whose task, execution ID, manifest, staged path set and blob set are recomputed by the consumer or verified in the same execution. Define non-interchangeable typed scope-validation and preapproval proof contracts and resolve their evidence identities uniquely.

findings.title: The green regression and mutation suites do not cover the two surviving production bypasses
findings.failure_condition: All declared 50 fixtures, seven mutations and five integration cases pass while default role-free change-scope accepts an unassigned path and final commit calculation accepts generic scope/preapproval PASS plus a caller boolean.

observed: the independent scope probe reproduced an authorization bypass
the independent production probe reproduced exit 0/GO

findings.impact: Case totals and the declared production-layer list provide false assurance and cannot support Candidate Gate passage.
findings.required_resolution: Add exact-set production cases and mutations for mandatory role resolution, unassigned changed paths, typed scope/preapproval proofs, forged live-stage booleans, staged path/blob recomputation and current-index binding.

findings.title: Lifecycle remains safely informational but its filed transition-validation claim is broader than production behavior
findings.failure_condition: A remediation COMPLETED event or review ARCHIVED event has no preceding STARTED transition.

reproduction.observed: PASS despite the event log containing standalone R4 COMPLETED and A4 ARCHIVED events.

findings.impact: No gate bypass occurs because phase-status is explicitly informational, may be stale and used_as_gate_input=false. However, the Remediation 5 statement that completion/archive without start fails closed is not implemented.
findings.required_resolution: Either narrow the filed lifecycle contract to deterministic projection of accepted snapshot events or enforce a defined transition automaton. Preserve informational authority and exclusion from gate inputs.
